panels.description: LIVE on-chain moniker read directly from the validator wallet contract ($node) via getIdentity() (eth_call 0x36afc6fa), ABI-decoded in the jq-backend parser.

targets.root_selector:
def h2i: reduce (explode[]) as $c (0; .*16 + (if $c>=97 then $c-87 elif $c>=65 then $c-55 else $c-48 end));
.result | ltrimstr("0x") as $h
| ( $h[64:128] | h2i ) as $moff
| (64 + $moff*2) as $lp
| ( $h[$lp:$lp+64] | h2i ) as $len
| $h[$lp+64 : $lp+64 + $len*2]
| [ range(0; length/2) as $i | .[$i*2:$i*2+2] | h2i ] | implode
| { onchain_name: . }
